title: Shift Leader
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Production Supervisor
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead a team within a Production unit or line to execute production processes, transforming parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely and cost\-effective manner. Each day, you will ensure continuous and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings, and quality and safety standards and policies. You will also showcase your expertise by organizing and allocating resources to meet line production targets effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 The work model for the role is:
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Motion business for IEC Low Voltage Division based in Faridabad, India.
   

  

 You will be mainly accountable for:
   

  

* Ensuring that production scheduling and production plan meet the volume requirements agreed upon in the demand plan and defined inventory service levels.
* Recommending technical equipment and facility improvements as necessary.
* Identifying deficiencies in production area, proposing improvement activities, and overseeing implementation of actions to improve production performance.
* Managing the resolution of critical product or equipment issues together with relevant internal teams.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* 7 to 12 years of experience in execution production activities for rotating field.
* Full time B.E/B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical.
* Provides guidance to the teams and seeks knowledge for their own development and coaching/mentoring of the teams.
* Builds effective, competent, and high\-performing teams.
* Accountable for the health and safety of all employees and contractors for the teams in scope, and continuous improvement in Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) processes and integrity performance.


**More About Us**
 The IEC Low Voltage Division is a technology leader delivering a full range of energy\-efficient low voltage motors, including ultra\-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Through a global footprint, domain expertise and rugged designs, the Division provides reliable technology that improves efficiency and productivity even in the most demanding applications.

title: IPD billing executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Batra Heart \& Multispeciality Hospital is a growing healthcare group with a workforce of over 100 professionals, including 3
   

 0 highly reputed doctors serving Faridabad and surrounding areas. The hospital offers state\-of\-the\-art facilities and caters to a diverse patient base, including community members, corporate employees, government staff, and prominent figures. The team focuses on delivering high\-quality medical services at affordable costs while meeting clearly defined requirements. The hospital is committed to continuous process improvement and regularly updates its standards to ensure services are accurate, efficient, and aligned with patient needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 The IPD Billing Executive is responsible for managing the complete inpatient billing cycle, from patient admission to discharge, ensuring accurate and timely generation of bills. This includes verifying patient details, recording services and procedures, coordinating with clinical and administrative teams, and processing invoicing and payments. The role involves checking insurance coverage, monitoring advance deposits, resolving billing queries, and maintaining clear documentation and records in accordance with hospital policies and regulatory requirements. The IPD Billing Executive will also support financial reporting related to inpatient revenue and help identify discrepancies or areas for process improvement. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based at Batra Heart \& Multispeciality Hospital in Faridabad.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong billing process and invoicing skills, with experience in end\-to\-end inpatient billing.
* Candidates should possess solid analytical skills and basic finance knowledge to review bills, reconcile accounts, and support revenue reporting.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills for interacting with patients, attendants, clinicians, and administrative staff.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in commerce, finance, hospital administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in hospital billing, IPD billing, or healthcare revenue cycle management is highly beneficial.
* Attention to detail, ability to work with hospital billing software, and familiarity with insurance and TPA processes are advantageous.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced clinical environment, manage multiple cases, and maintain confidentiality of patient information.

title: Counselor

**Qualifications**
 Strong counseling and mentoring skills
   

  

 Excellent communication and active listening abilities

 Prior experience as a school/academic counselor preferred
   

  

 Knowledge of child/adolescent development and exam systems
   

  

 Comfortable working in a fast\-paced academic environment

title: Retention Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hobfit is a tech\-enabled health platform focused on reimagining women’s health through science\-based, personalized care. The company combines medical expertise, AI\-powered home workouts, and habit\-driven coaching to help users manage issues such as weight loss, PCOS, thyroid, blood pressure, fatigue, hormonal imbalances, and gynecological conditions. Hobfit serves a large and growing user base across multiple countries, supported by hundreds of doctors, dieticians, and certified coaches. Its platform features biomarker\-based personalization, integrated lab tests, trackers for calories and periods, and culturally grounded nutrition plans. With a strong emphasis on root\-cause solutions and community support, Hobfit empowers women to sustainably reclaim control over their health.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Retention Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Faridabad. This role involves closely engaging with users to understand their needs, address concerns, and ensure they remain active and satisfied with Hobfit’s programs and services. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include monitoring user engagement metrics, conducting follow\-ups via calls or messages, resolving issues, and coordinating with medical and coaching teams to deliver timely support. The Retention Specialist will also identify patterns in user behavior, propose retention strategies, and contribute to continuous improvement of customer experience. Collaboration with cross\-functional teams and clear documentation of interactions are essential parts of the role.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Customer Retention skills, with experience in reducing churn and improving user loyalty.
* Candidates should possess excellent Interpersonal Skills and Communication abilities to build trust and engage diverse users effectively.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret engagement data, identify trends, and recommend retention\-focused actions.
* Candidates should possess a commitment to Customer Satisfaction, with a service\-oriented mindset and problem\-solving approach.
* Relevant experience in healthcare, wellness, or subscription\-based services is beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site in Faridabad, manage multiple conversations, and use CRM or customer support tools effectively.
* Preferred qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in business, communications, psychology, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills, resilience in handling challenging situations, and a collaborative working style are advantageous.
